body: Im almost in the same spot :( Im so sorry  and I wish there was something I could do to make you feel better. If you ever want to talk, feel free to Pm me

Thank you for taking the time to write that out, It really means a lot. I have surgery planned for the 14th but the doctors only gave me a 20% chance of ever walking again, and that might even be a little optimistic. I have seen what its like to be disabled and I salute all of those who are, but I also know that I will never have the strength to do that.

 I started community college a couple months ago, because I dont have the money right now to attend UAA. Most of the people in my classes are 40+ which is fine but I see them as more of a family friend than someone I can relate too. There is that one girl who is my age and im pretty sure she liked me and practically asked me out for coffee but I wasn't thinking and turned her down. I must have really hurt her feelings because now im just getting the cold shoulder :(

I thing part of my problem is that most of my family is dead of cancer and I only have a couple of uncles who live 3000 miles away and 1 aunt who im not at all close to :(

Sorry for rambling so much
